episodes.title: I Was Born Into a Cult. This Is How I Got Out.
episodes.description:
I was born into a cult.
I didn't choose it. It was the only world I knew.
For years I accepted what I had been taught without question. Leaving meant risking my family, my community, and everything that had defined my identity. Looking back now, I can see how easy it is for sincere people to become trapped in high-control belief systems—and how difficult it can be to walk away.
This is my story.
In this video I share what life was like growing up inside a cult, what finally caused me to question everything, the cost of leaving, and the unexpected freedom I found on the other side.
This isn't an attack on the people I left behind. Many were kind, sincere, and doing what they believed was right. My goal is simply to tell the truth about my own experience in the hope that it helps someone else who may be asking difficult questions.
If this story resonates with you, I'd love to hear from you in the comments.
